(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define dirs4 (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
    (define (e8b-paste grid pat top left)
      (for*/fold ((out grid)) ((r (in-range (rows pat))) (c (in-range (cols pat))))
        (let ((v (at pat r c)) (rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c)))
          (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows out) (cols out)))
              (set-cell out rr cc v)
              out))))
    (define (e5b-nz-components grid)
      (let loop-pos ((positions (grid-positions grid)) (seen (list)) (acc (list)))
        (cond
          ((empty? positions) (reverse acc))
          ((or (member? (first positions) seen)
               (= (at grid (first (first positions)) (second (first positions))) 0))
           (loop-pos (rest positions) seen acc))
          (else
           (let bfs ((queue (list (first positions)))
                     (seen2 (cons (first positions) seen))
                     (cells (list)))
             (if (empty? queue)
                 (loop-pos (rest positions) seen2 (cons (reverse cells) acc))
                 (let* ((cur (first queue))
                        (nbrs
                         (filter
                          (lambda (p)
                            (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                 (not (member? p seen2))
                                 (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))))
                          (map (lambda (d)
                                 (list (+ (first cur) (first d))
                                       (+ (second cur) (second d))))
                               dirs4))))
                   (bfs (append (rest queue) nbrs)
                        (append seen2 nbrs)
                        (cons cur cells)))))))))
    (define (s17b-gallery-row objs (gap 1))
      (if (empty? objs)
          (list (list 0))
          (let* ((h (apply max (map rows objs)))
                 (w (+ (apply + (map cols objs)) (* gap (- (length objs) 1)))))
            (let loop ((rest-objs objs) (left 0) (out (empty-grid h w 0)))
              (if (empty? rest-objs)
                  out
                  (let ((obj (first rest-objs)))
                    (loop (rest rest-objs)
                          (+ left (cols obj) gap)
                          (e8b-paste out obj 0 left))))))))
    (define (s6-component-grid grid cells)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                      (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))
                      (lambda (r c)
                        (let ((rr (+ (first bb) r)) (cc (+ (second bb) c)))
                          (if (member? (list rr cc) cells) (at grid rr cc) 0))))))
    (define (s6b-component-crop grid cells) (s6-component-grid grid cells))
    (define (s6b-transform-key grid key)
      (cond ((= key 1) grid)
            ((= key 2) (rotate-cw grid))
            ((= key 3) (rotate-180 grid))
            ((= key 4) (flip-lr grid))
            (else grid)))
    (let* ((legend (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (rest (first g))))
           (body (subgrid g 2 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
           (components (e5b-nz-components body))
           (first-color (first legend))
           (control-cells
            (first
             (filter
              (lambda (comp)
                (= (at body (first (first comp)) (second (first comp))) first-color))
              components)))
           (control-size (length control-cells))
           (key (cond ((= control-size 3) 2)
                      ((= control-size 4) 3)
                      ((= control-size 5) 4)
                      (else 1)))
           (parts
            (for/list ((color (in-list legend)))
              (let ((crop
                     (s6b-component-crop
                      body
                      (first
                       (filter
                        (lambda (comp)
                          (= (at body (first (first comp)) (second (first comp))) color))
                        components)))))
                (s6b-transform-key crop key)))))
      (s17b-gallery-row parts 1))))
